installCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('client')&&fs.existsSync('server')){cp.execSync('npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execSync('npm install',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('client')&&fs.existsSync('server')){cp.execSync('npm run build --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server',{stdio:'inherit'})}else if(fs.existsSync('src/App.jsx')){cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else if(fs.existsSync('prisma')){cp.execSync('npm run prisma:generate',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
